tasks.subject: Coordinate histogram-family native support
tasks.description: Container task for executing the approved histogram-family plan from .pi/path2-native-sql-100-compliance-plan.md in the recommended order: shared classic histogram materialization, histogram_count/sum/avg, histogram_quantile, histogram_fraction, then histogram-focused validation and harness coverage. Scope is classic histogram series over the current TimeSeries-backed model only; Prometheus native histogram samples remain out of scope. Semantic references: ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/functions.go, ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile.go, ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile_test.go, and ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/promqltest/testdata/histograms.test.

tasks.subject: Add shared classic histogram materialization
tasks.description: Implement the shared native lowering/materialization substrate for classic histogram series (_bucket, _sum, _count). Add fragment/state needed to recognize histogram inputs, group bucket series into histogram identities by labelset minus le, parse and sort le boundaries, merge duplicate boundaries where required, carry count/sum siblings where needed, and define the shared data shape that histogram_count, histogram_sum, histogram_avg, histogram_quantile, and histogram_fraction will consume. Target likely files: internal/promshim/native/types.go, internal/promshim/native/analysis.go, internal/promshim/native/renderer.go, and specialized helpers in internal/promshim/storage/*.go. Use Prometheus classic semantics as reference from ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/functions.go and ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile.go. Include targeted comments where invariant-heavy grouping/sorting/merging behavior is non-obvious.

tasks.subject: Implement native histogram_count for direct lowerable histogram inputs
tasks.description: Add native SQL lowering for histogram_count when the child histogram input is already a directly lowerable instant-vector native fragment (for example classic histogram bucket selectors and other directly renderable native-child shapes). Use the shared classic histogram materialization layer to normalize bucket series into grouped buckets and produce native root plans for instant and range query modes. Prometheus semantic references remain ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/functions.go and classic histogram helpers in ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile.go, while broader grouped/rate-fed histogram input lowering is tracked separately.

tasks.subject: Implement native histogram_sum for direct lowerable histogram inputs
tasks.description: Add native SQL lowering for histogram_sum when the child histogram input is already a directly lowerable instant-vector native fragment. Reuse the shared classic histogram materialization layer and native projection renderer for instant and range query modes. Broader grouped/rate-fed histogram input lowering is tracked separately.

tasks.subject: Implement native histogram_avg for direct lowerable histogram inputs
tasks.description: Add native SQL lowering for histogram_avg when the child histogram input is already a directly lowerable instant-vector native fragment. Reuse the shared classic histogram materialization layer and native projection renderer for instant and range query modes. Broader grouped/rate-fed histogram input lowering is tracked separately.

tasks.subject: Implement native histogram_quantile
tasks.description: Add native SQL lowering for histogram_quantile for classic histograms. Reproduce Prometheus BucketQuantile semantics: grouping by labels minus le, sorting boundaries, merging duplicate boundaries, monotonicity enforcement before interpolation, sparse/empty behavior, q edge behavior, and relevant error/info surface where representable in this repo. Primary references: ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/functions.go, ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile.go, ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile_test.go, and classic histogram testdata.

tasks.subject: Implement native histogram_fraction
tasks.description: Add native SQL lowering for histogram_fraction for classic histograms. Reproduce Prometheus BucketFraction semantics, including lower/upper bound handling, interpolation behavior, -Inf/+Inf handling, sparse/empty behavior, and degenerate bound cases. Primary references: ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/functions.go, ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile.go, and classic histogram testdata.

tasks.subject: Add histogram validation and harness coverage
tasks.description: Add or extend focused unit/integration/harness coverage for the histogram-family native path, including grouped multi-label cases, sparse or missing buckets, repeated bucket boundaries, missing +Inf bucket behavior where applicable, rate-fed classic histogram inputs, and dataset-variant validation including histogram_burst. Regenerate or update matrix/alignment artifacts if support status changes materially. Keep harness/compliance/ read-only.
tasks.activeForm: Adding histogram validation and harness coverage

tasks.subject: Enable grouped and rate-fed histogram input lowering
tasks.description: Extend the histogram-family native path so grouped and rate-fed classic histogram inputs can feed histogram_count, histogram_sum, histogram_avg, histogram_quantile, and histogram_fraction. This is the missing prerequisite discovered during execution: canonical histogram-family queries like sum by (le, job) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) are not yet representable as native histogram child input because the current native aggregation path only accepts a narrower source subset. Implement the required native aggregation-over-child or histogram-specific grouped bucket rendering so histogram-family roots can consume grouped/rate-fed bucket vectors in native SQL. References: .pi/path2-native-sql-100-compliance-plan.md, ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/functions.go, ~/code/external/prometheus/promql/quantile.go, and histogram testdata.
tasks.activeForm: Enabling grouped and rate-fed histogram input lowering
